approach.method_basis: The Parent breeds fresh molecular graphs from a score-ranked survivor population using crossover and local mutations, admits stable canonical identities through its source-relative sulfur gate, and learns a count-fingerprint Gaussian process from accepted observations in the current session. It buys a batch by taking a maximum from each correlated posterior sample while excluding earlier selections. After three announcements without an incumbent improvement, it restricts the pool to the forty highest original posterior means; an improvement resets that restriction. The Parent already removed a dormant rejection-conditioned mutation-length floor and otherwise retains this generator, fitted model, sampling law and feedback loop.
approach.novelty: Remove the sampled residual from the choice rule only while the existing stall restriction is inactive: choose each remaining molecule by its original posterior mean, while still computing the original samples and retaining their numerical checks. This tests whether residual-driven exploration contributes during unrestricted announcements. Same-Parent siblings changed restricted correlation, restricted mean location, ordinary mutation continuation, or the allocation/controller method; none measured this unrestricted residual-presence consumer. The complementary restricted-state ticket answers a separate conditional question and is not an additive arm of this result.

observed_bottleneck: The Parent converts generated alternatives into uneven useful progress, and the utility of its residual-driven choices outside the existing stall mask is unresolved. Its actual three seed summaries and run logs are complete: macro mean 0.607030316211131, population SD 0.030175277546149237, with 4350 accepted optimizer observations; full/late incumbent-gain mass is 5.978073077532332/1.0224077547621127. Independent read-only reconstruction of all fifteen Parent log/trajectory pairs reproduces the frozen Search replay: 347 unrestricted announcements, 3259/3470 differing sequence positions, 344 differing purchased sets, 3021 same-available choice disagreements and 2056 displaced original paid identities, 909 late. Mean-only re-decision raises the total original predicted-mean sum by 89.93111560617072 on these saved pools; no alternative reward is known. Evidence and hashes are in policy/scratch/r0060-03-improve-L01/evidence-audit.json and its audit-seed files, which cite every underlying Parent log and trajectory file. The older full residual removal n-f04cec6ab705 loses 0.11631688199011732 on its different mask-free host; n-189cd716f027 changes stall amplitude there and loses 0.009718278967626004. Current-Parent restricted correlation and mean-location removals n-5e03d3ccd1b7/n-8e00e5e9fc34 lose 0.008352681729073996/0.023092425745076712 while retaining residuals. qPO screen/correlation controls n-0e978ade2613/n-61819156f98f concern another allocation objective. These results support a conservative utility prediction but do not identify this state-scoped residual contribution.

literature_review.conclusion: Reuse search-policy-r60-state-and-count-consumers as frozen, with internal_evidence basis and empty adoptions. Its source distinguishes posterior-sampled optimization from mean maximization but does not supply this state-scoped experiment or transfer a Bayesian guarantee. The exact code Parent, retained mask and mean consumers, independent passive masks, same draw consumption and observable-to-feedback joins define the test. The reviewed misspecification and fragment-generation alternatives remain outside this frozen intervention; no second arm, new asset or dependency is introduced.

Its actual search queries and primary-source findings are retained in that source review; no new search is claimed here. This ticket is an existing-consumer contribution control, supported by source-pinned current-Parent actual-state replay and the distinct previous consumer-removal results. It introduces no new model, package or external algorithm. The state predicate and consumer are those already in Parent code, so empty adoptions correctly records that no published construction is newly implemented.

hypothesis: On code Parent n-cf8d309c06de, remove only m-000000000006 sampled residual influence from the successful allocation consumer when restrict_top_mean is None at announcement. Keep the original fitted mean mu, score scale s, full covariance, actual successful Cholesky factor L, standard-normal array Z and original P=mu[None,:]+s*(Z@L.T), including the original finite guard and failure routing. At every position of an unrestricted successful announcement choose the lowest original pool index attaining the largest original mu among currently available indices. Remove the chosen index from the active availability mask exactly once. Every restricted successful announcement continues choosing the maximum original P row on the original top-mean eligible set and original sequential masks. The direct causal path is residual-consumer removal -> changed unrestricted molecular identities with weakly higher original mean at a shared available set, and weakly higher batch summed original mean -> accepted feedback and its downstream population/fit. At least one changed paid set and a strictly positive aggregate original-mean gain versus the separately masked passive original sequence are predicted. Higher original means need not produce higher realized scores; the conservative utility prediction is that removing useful residual exploration decreases the complete endpoint mean. This changes neither cross-candidate correlation alone nor residual amplitude, fitted covariance, mean location, eligibility, or the state predicate.

finding_summary.headline: Unrestricted residual exploration is useful: mean-only choices narrow search and lose 0.0944 in endpoint score
finding_summary.insights: On this retained host, sampled residual influence outside the stall restriction contributes useful exploration beyond greedily maximizing the fitted mean. The result prices that consumer conditionally; it does not show that every sampled component is useful, identify correlation separately, or establish a transferable benefit on another host. More local wins and smaller selected-stream prediction error were not reliable substitutes for final progress: full mean-squared prediction error fell from 0.011599 to 0.004092 while endpoints worsened. Paid search concentrated on related structures: nonempty typed/generic scaffold identities fell from 1,667/951 to 948/452, and nearest-prior-archive similarity after excluding molecules below twelve heavy atoms rose from 0.7322 to 0.8110. This is consistent with a loss of exploratory breadth, but does not prove that scaffold contraction mediates the score loss. Chemistry also remained uneven. Tiny fragments became rarer, yet above-fifty-heavy-atom purchases increased from 44 to 260, including 229 late purchases; peroxide-containing output increased from 118 to 516. Ring-rich generation is already available, while attachment context, controlled growth and explicit stereochemistry remain weak. A search scheme that preserves multiple chemically plausible families, together with context-preserving scaffold or linker moves, could address that observed limitation; this experiment neither implements nor validates such a method. The full panel, both size tails, adaptive gate-zero cells, unchanged sets and terminally censored purchases remain included. Passive alternatives have no measured outcomes, and the restricted and unrestricted interventions cannot be added together. Ending or replacing the approach remains a later planning decision.
finding_summary.results: The removal executed cleanly. Across all fifteen sessions, 343 unrestricted announcements made 3,430 paid choices by the original predicted mean, while all 920 choices in the 92 restricted announcements retained their original sampled rule. Relative to an independently masked replay of the original rule at those same states, 341 purchased sets changed, 2,115 paid identities were different and the summed original predicted means rose by 80.584. Every paid identity joined real feedback. The complete endpoint mean nevertheless fell from 0.607030 to 0.512644, a difference of -0.094386; the three paired seed differences were -0.172229, -0.047378 and -0.063552. Thirteen task/seed endpoints fell, one rose and one tied. The loss exceeds the registered descriptive 0.002 scale. Full incumbent-gain mass fell from 5.978073 to 4.562278 over 4,350 purchases, although positive improvement events increased from 253 to 271. Late gain mass moved in the opposite direction to its conservative prediction, rising from 1.022408 to 1.401443 over all 2,175 late purchases. This late increase is real, but it does not recover the complete endpoint loss.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
